meta_description:
143 likes, 4 comments - momspresso on June 5, 2023: "#repost @world.of.yuvi Thanks for tagging us

Mommies can you relate??? 🙆‍♀️

To the tired mom, I see you. Mom fatigue is a very real thing. From the day you gave birth, you can’t stop worrying, you are responsible for caring, loving & keeping alive this beautiful child. Apart from that we also need to contribute towards work, family meals, household chores, running errands & whatnot which in turn makes us feel more fatigue.

The responsibility is just never going to end - days, weeks, months & years. Somedays we feel like crying & pouring our hearts out but when we look at our child, we momentarily forget about our tired mind & body. We feel like every tired moment is worth it. Because someone now calls you a MOM ❤️

#Momspresso #mumfie #mom #mother #momlife #motherhoodjourney #beautiful #momstruggles #parenting #parentinglife #childbirth #baby #toddler #pregnancy #POTD".
